description: The ballot number B(n, k) = (n-k+1)/(n+1) * binom(n+k, k), for 0 <= k <= n. B(n, n) is the nth Catalan number. k above n is rejected. Both indexes run up to 2048. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/ballot
